title: CrafterDojo: An Integrated Research Suite for Building Open-Ended Embodied Agents in Crafter
claim: A unified suite of data generators and foundation models lets researchers build new agents in a lightweight environment.
layout: 3 regions, left-to-right flow, color-coded boxes with labeled title tabs
description: A left-to-right system diagram with rounded containers, each topped by an orange title tab. At left, a Crafter game screenshot (pixel-art map) sends observations o_t into the CrafterDojo Toolkit and receives actions a_t back. The toolkit holds two dashed sub-blocks. The upper one, Expert Behavior Demonstration, has a green Expert Behavior Generator that produces CrafterPlay, a strip of observation and action frames. The lower one, Video-Caption, has a blue Caption Generator that produces CrafterCaption, frames with a caption like 'place table on grass'. Arrows carry the datasets to the CrafterDojo Foundation Suite at lower right. That suite contains C-VPT (Behavioral Foundation) and C-CLIP (Vision-Language Model), which merge into a purple C-Steve-1 (Instruction-Following) box. Arrows from the suite point up to a top-right panel, New Open-Ended Agent Research, which shows Agent 1, Agent 2, ..., Agent N.
caption: Overview of \ours components. \ours provides two automatic dataset generation toolkits (Expert Behavior Generator and Caption Generator) that automatically generate large-scale datasets to train three foundation models: \cvpt for behavioral foundation, \cclip for vision-language grounding, and \csteveone for instruction-following in Crafter. With these models, datasets, and toolkits, researchers can efficiently develop new agents without the overhead of working in the heavy and complex Minecraft environment.
abstract: Foundation models are central to building general-purpose embodied agents. Minecraft has become the dominant testbed for this paradigm, but its computational and engineering overhead limits rapid iteration and controlled analysis. Crafter offers a lightweight alternative yet lacks the foundation model ecosystem required for such research. We introduce CrafterDojo, a suite of foundation models, datasets, and data-generation toolkits that establishes Crafter as a testbed for foundation-model-based embodied intelligence, providing CrafterVPT, CrafterCLIP, and CrafterSteve-1. To address Crafter's data scarcity, CrafterDojo includes automatic tools that generate diverse synthetic demonstrations and aligned video-language pairs, yielding the CrafterPlay and CrafterCaption datasets. Experiments show that these datasets support effective foundation model training and enable hierarchical agents that outperform non-hierarchical baselines on long-horizon tasks. We release all code, models, and datasets at https://github.com/frechele/CrafterDojo.
